items.title: Take a short walk after meals
items.text: In real adults (CGMacros), a walk after a meal went with a rise only about 3.2 mg/dL smaller (95% CI -6.9 to 0.5): not distinguishable from zero. Your sugar rose about 14.9 mg/dL less after meals when you walked. Aim for 10 to 20 minutes after dinner, where the synthetic program saw the biggest gain (18.3 mg/dL).

rejected.text: Aim to walk for 10 to 20 minutes after dinner to help with your sugar. Walking after meals went with a rise in sugar about 14.9 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Try to start dinner before 8 pm as sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Sugar also rose about 13.3 mg/dL more after a dinner at 8-9 pm than after one before 6 pm.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 9.4 hours, with 33.3% of nights reaching 13 hours. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
